en: Vintage postcard with a central photograph of a multi‑story building with decorative tilework and wrought‑iron balconies. In front of the building is a commercial shop with bolts of fabric and textiles hanging outside and displayed on tables, with several people standing and shopping. Above and below the photo, red printed text identifies the location as Nazareth and the commercial house of Antonio Carvalho Laranjo.
